frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Apprehension proportioned to the appraised weight of its object: an estimation-grounded, object-directed fear of a source or eventuality judged to have power over one's outcomes, which operates without the threat being perceptually present (بالغيب, أن-clauses about projected futures) and which regulates present conduct (withholding, yielding, compliance, preemptive action).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Apprehension proportioned to the appraised weight of its object: an estimation-grounded, object-directed fear of a source or eventuality judged to have power over one's outcomes, which operates without the threat being perceptually present (بالغيب, أن-clauses about projected futures) and which regulates present conduct (withholding, yielding, compliance, preemptive action).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 48 occurrences, خشي is never fear of a present, perceived danger; it is always apprehension keyed to an APPRAISAL of what its object could do or bring about. Three corpus-internal signals establish this. (1) Knowledge-linkage: 35:28 makes خشية of God the mark of العلماء specifically; 79:19 sequences guidance-to-the-Lord then فتخشى; the reminder cluster (20:3, 20:44, 79:26, 87:10) treats خشية as the receptivity that a تذكرة/عبرة activates. Fear here follows from knowing/estimating the object's weight. (2) Absence-compatibility: خشية repeatedly takes unseen or future objects — the Lord بالغيب (21:49, 35:18, 36:11, 50:33, 67:12), a Day (31:33), the Hour (79:45), and projected eventualities via أن-clauses (18:80, 20:94, 5:52) or anticipated states (إملاق 17:31, الإنفاق 17:100, كساد 9:24, العنت 4:25). (3) Conduct-regulation: خشية explains withholding spending (17:100), infanticide (17:31), hypocrites' alliances (5:52), preemptive intervention (18:80), Aaron's inaction (20:94), and is what the allocation-correction imperatives redirect (فلا تخشوهم واخشون 2:150, 5:3, 5:44; الله أحق أن تخشاه 33:37, 9:13; لم يخش إلا الله 9:18; لا يخشون أحدا إلا الله 33:39). Because it is appraisal-based, it is gradable and comparable (4:77 كخشية الله أو أشد خشية) and can be misallocated — the corpus's recurrent polemic is precisely about re-ranking whose weight one apprehends. The inanimate cases (stones falling من خشية الله 2:74; the mountain crumbling 59:21) confirm the residue is response-to-appraised-overwhelming-weight rather than a merely human emotion.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Only two morphological slots occur: bare Form I verb (40x) and the verbal noun خشية (8x) — no derived stems, so no Form II/IV overlay to subtract. Construction layers identified and subtracted: (a) direct-object construction (God/Lord/people/a Day/the Hour/trade-decline) supplies WHAT is appraised; (b) أن-clause construction (18:80, 20:94, 5:52) supplies a projected eventuality as object; (c) absolute objectless use (20:3, 20:44, 20:77, 79:19, 79:26, 80:9, 87:10, 4:9) profiles the disposition itself; (d) من خشية + genitive (2:74, 21:28, 23:57, 59:21) profiles خشية as causal source of a further reaction (falling, إشفاق); (e) كخشية/أشد خشية (4:77) shows gradability. The same residue — appraisal-grounded apprehension of a weighty object — survives under all five constructions; what varies (object type, polarity of evaluation, ensuing behavior) is carried by construction and context, not by the root.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 18:80 (فخشينا أن يرهقهما طغيانا وكفرا): the speaker is the "We" of the Khidr narrative, and attributing a raw fear-emotion there strains. It is reconciled only under the appraisal-based formulation — an estimation of a weighty projected outcome motivating preemptive action — whose أن-clause construction exactly parallels the uncontroversial human cases 20:94 (خشيت أن تقول) and 5:52 (نخشى أن تصيبنا). Secondary pressure comes from 2:74 and 59:21 (stones/mountain من خشية الله), where "anticipation of future harm" strains but "yielding response to appraised overwhelming weight" holds; these two cases actively support the weight-appraisal residue over a narrow emotion reading.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: (1) "خشي = reverent awe restricted to God/the sacred": refuted internally, since خشية takes poverty (17:31), spending (17:100), trade-slump (9:24), distress (4:25), people (4:77, 33:37), and a feared misfortune (5:52) as objects. (2) "خشي is a plain synonym of خوف (generic fear)": weakened by three minimal pairs in the same verses — 13:21 assigns يخشون to the Lord but يخافون to the bad reckoning; 20:77 gives خوف the concrete danger (دركا) and خشية the absolute slot; 4:9 switches from وليخش (absolute, of the appraised scenario) to خافوا عليهم (fear-FOR a beneficiary, a construction خشي never takes in the corpus). خشي is fear-OF an appraised source, never fear-FOR someone.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Versus خوف: خشي never occurs with على (fear for another) in the packet, is the member selected for knowledge-conditioned fear (35:28) and بالغيب contexts, and takes the being-of-standing while خوف takes the concrete outcome when both co-occur (13:21, 20:77). Versus شفق: the three co-occurrences (21:28, 21:49, 23:57) all make إشفاق flow FROM خشية (من خشيته مشفقون), so خشية is the prior appraisal-state, إشفاق its tender-anxious expression. Versus وقى/تقوى: coordinated as distinct conjuncts (24:52 ويخش الله ويتقه; 31:33 اتقوا ربكم واخشوا يوما), so خشية is the appraisal-affect while تقوى is the protective practice it motivates. Falsifiable: the hypothesis predicts خشي should never appear for startle-fear at a present perceived stimulus (contrast خوف in 20:67-68-type contexts) nor in fear-for-someone constructions — no occurrence in the full set violates either prediction.
internal_discovery.rationale: All 48 confirmed occurrences were individually assessed and every one is reconcilable with the proposed residue after subtracting construction and context; the خوف minimal pairs, the علماء/بالغيب/تذكرة collocations, and the gradable allocation-correction constructions give the residue independent, corpus-internal support. Strength is MODERATE rather than STRONG because three occurrences (18:80, 2:74, 59:21) fit only under the refined appraisal-of-weight formulation, not under a naive fear-emotion reading — the residue holds universally, but its precise phrasing is load-bearing for those cases, and nothing here is canonical.

adversarial_verification.notes:
Packet = 48 confirmed occurrences (8 N, 40 V), full coverage read and accounted for. The proposed contribution is a loaded BUNDLE; I decomposed it into: (1) apprehension, (2) estimation-grounded/proportioned to appraised weight, (3) object-directed, (4) object with power over outcomes, (5) operates WITHOUT the threat perceptually present (بالغيب/projected futures), (6) regulates present conduct.

CORE SURVIVES + IS DISTINCTIVE: Components 1-4 hold across all 48 (elided objects recoverable in absolute uses 20:3, 79:26, 80:9, 87:10, 20:44, 79:19 via context = God/the Hour). The appraisal-of-weight residue is genuinely distinctive vs nearest roots, esp. خوف: خشي is repeatedly paired-and-contrasted with خاف (13:21 يخشون ربهم + يخافون سوء الحساب; 4:9; 20:77 لا تخاف دركا ولا تخشى), graded by intensity (4:77 كخشية الله أو أشد خشية), and tied to knowledge (35:28 إنما يخشى الله من عباده العلماء). So distinctiveness_ok = true for the core; falsifiable = true (it makes per-occurrence predictions, and some are falsified).

BUNDLE FAILS on two RIDERS that are contextual effects smuggled into the root residue, not universal:
- Rider (5) 'without perceptual presence' FAILS where the feared object is concrete/present: 3:173 (فاخشوهم toward a reported, presently-mustered army — not بالغيب), 9:13 (أتخشونهم toward already-actualized aggressors who broke oaths and attacked first), 21:28 (angels من خشيته مشفقون in immediate divine presence). The بالغيب gloss covers only a subset (21:49, 35:18, 36:11, 50:33, 67:12), not all.
- Rider (6) 'regulates present conduct' FAILS where خشية is predicated as an involuntary state/reaction: 39:23 (تقشعر منه جلود — involuntary somatic response, not conduct), 80:9 (وهو يخشى — bare state predication); 23:57 borderline descriptive-trait.

Because the proposal AS STATED includes riders (5) and (6) as part of the contribution and these are not demonstrably present in every confirmed occurrence, universal presence of the FULL claim does not hold under non-negotiable unity → not SUPPORTED. Because the essential distinctive residue (estimation-grounded, object-directed apprehension proportioned to the object's appraised weight) is universal and distinctive → not REFUTED. Net: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED. A residue restricted to that core would likely reach SUPPORTED; the two behavioral/epistemic riders should be reclassified as CONTEXT.
